mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.PASSWORD_HASH FROM APP_USER U WHERE LOWER(U.EMAIL) = LOWER(#{EMAIL})
SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL FROM USER_TOKEN T JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.USER_ID WHERE T.TOKEN = #{TOKEN} AND T.EXPIRES_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APP_USER (USER_NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH) VALUES (#{USER_NAME}, LOWER(#{EMAIL}), #{PASSWORD_HASH})
mapper.update: UPDATE APP_USER SET LAST_LOGIN_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = CAST(#{USER_ID} AS BIGINT)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_TOKEN (TOKEN, USER_ID, EXPIRES_AT) VALUES (#{TOKEN}, CAST(#{USER_ID} AS BIGINT), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + CAST(#{DAYS} AS INT) * INTERVAL '1 day')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_TOKEN WHERE EXPIRES_AT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
